arxiv-1805-05635.title: Measurement of the nuclear modification factor for inclusive jets in Pb+Pb collisions at s NN = 5.02 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=5.02 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1805-05635.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1805-05635.description: Abstract Measurements of the yield and nuclear modification factor, R AA R_{\mathrm{AA}} , for inclusive jet production are performed using 0.49 0.49 nb -1 of Pb+Pb data at s NN = 5.02 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=5.02 TeV and 25 pb -1 of p ​ p pp data at s = 5.02 \sqrt{s}=5.02 TeV with the ATLAS detector at the LHC.

arxiv-1811-03722.title: Witnessing quantum memory in non-Markovian processes
arxiv-1811-03722.creator: Christina Giarmatzi, Fabio Costa
arxiv-1811-03722.description: Abstract We present a method to detect quantum memory in a non-Markovian process. We call a process Markovian when the environment does not provide a memory that retains correlations across different system-environment interactions. We define two types of non-Markovian processes, depending on the required memory being classical or quantum.

arxiv-2003-06101.title: Study of nuclear matter properties for Hybrid EoS
arxiv-2003-06101.creator: Ishfaq A. Rather, A. A. Usmani, S. K. Patra
arxiv-2003-06101.description: Abstract We study the nuclear matter properties like symmetry energy, slope parameter, curvature, skewness and incompressibility for Hybrid EoS. The hybrid EoS is constructed by combining the hadron phase with the quark phase. For the hadron phase, we use the recently proposed Effective-Field-Theory motivated Relativistic Mean-Field model (E-RMF) with different parameter sets.

arxiv-2111-02804.title: On the dynamical and morphological state of the CHEX-MATE clusters
arxiv-2111-02804.creator: \firstname Maria Giulia \lastname Campitiello \fnsep, \firstname Stefano \lastname Ettori, \firstname Lorenzo \lastname Lovisari and the CHEX-MATE collaboration
arxiv-2111-02804.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by \firstname Maria Giulia \lastname Campitiello \fnsep, \firstname Stefano \lastname Ettori, \firstname Lorenzo \lastname Lovisari and the CHEX-MATE collaboration. The CHEX-MATE sample was built to provide an overview of the statistical properties of the underlying cluster population and to set the stage for future X-ray missions. In this work, we perform a morphological analysis of the 118 clusters included in the sample with the aim to provide a classification of their dynamical state which will be useful for future studies of the collaboration.

arxiv-2204-08829.title: A new method for directly computing reduced density matrices
arxiv-2204-08829.creator: Christian Käding, Mario Pitschmann
arxiv-2204-08829.description: Abstract We demonstrate the power of a first principle-based and practicable method that allows for the perturbative computation of reduced density matrix elements of an open quantum system without making use of any master equations. The approach is based on techniques from non-equilibrium quantum field theory like thermo field dynamics, the Schwinger-Keldsyh formalism, and the Feynman-Vernon influence functional.

arxiv-2209-14142.title: From Zero to Production: Baltic-Ukrainian Machine Translation Systems to Aid Refugees
arxiv-2209-14142.creator: Toms BERGMANIS and Mārcis PINNIS
arxiv-2209-14142.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Toms BERGMANIS and Mārcis PINNIS. In this paper, we examine the development and usage of six low-resource machine translation systems translating between the Ukrainian language and each of the official languages of the Baltic states. We developed these systems in reaction to the escalating Ukrainian refugee crisis caused by the Russian military aggression in Ukraine in the hope that they might be helpful for refugees and public administrations. Now, two months after MT systems were made public, we analyze their usage patterns and statistics.

arxiv-2405-01731.title: Dynamic Anisotropic Smoothing for Noisy Derivative-Free Optimization
arxiv-2405-01731.creator: Sam Reifenstein ∗, Timothee Leleu ∗, Yoshihisa Yamamoto
arxiv-2405-01731.description: Abstract We propose a novel algorithm that extends the methods of ball smoothing and Gaussian smoothing for noisy derivative-free optimization by accounting for the heterogeneous curvature of the objective function. The algorithm dynamically adapts the shape of the smoothing kernel to approximate the Hessian of the objective function around a local optimum.

arxiv-2412-17329.title: SoK: The Design Paradigm of Safe and Secure Defaults
arxiv-2412-17329.creator: Jukka Ruohonen
arxiv-2412-17329.description: Abstract In security engineering, including software security engineering, there is a well-known design paradigm telling to prefer safe and secure defaults. The paper presents a systematization of knowledge (SoK) of this paradigm by the means of a systematic mapping study and a scoping review of relevant literature.

arxiv-2506-18924.title: Connecting Vision and Emissions: A Behavioural AI Approach to Carbon Estimation in Road Design
arxiv-2506-18924.creator: Ammar K Al Mhdawi, Nonso Nnamoko, Safanah Mudheher Raafat, M.K.S. Al-Mhdawi, Amjad J Humaidi
arxiv-2506-18924.description: Abstract In this paper, we present an enhanced YOLOv8 real-time vehicle detection and classification framework, named YOLOv8-Deep, designed specifically for estimating carbon emissions in urban highway environments. The system enhances the state-of-the-art YOLOv8 architecture to accurately detect, segment, and track vehicles from live traffic video streams.

arxiv-2506-21951.title: HighRateMOS: Sampling-Rate Aware Modeling for Speech Quality Assessment Thanks: † Equal Contribution to this work.
arxiv-2506-21951.creator: Wenze Ren, Yi-Cheng Lin, Wen-Chin Huang, Ryandhimas E. Zezario, Szu-Wei Fu, Sung-Feng Huang, Erica Cooper, Haibin Wu, Hung-Yu Wei, Hsin-Min Wang, Hung-yi Lee, Yu Tsao
arxiv-2506-21951.description: Abstract Modern speech quality prediction models are trained on audio data resampled to a specific sampling rate. When faced with higher-rate audio at test time, these models can produce biased scores. We introduce HighRateMOS, the first non-intrusive mean opinion score (MOS) model that explicitly considers sampling rate.

arxiv-2507-04890.title: Emergence of local ordering and giant number fluctuations in active turbulence
arxiv-2507-04890.creator: Kirti Kashyap, Kolluru Venkata Kiran, Anupam Gupta
arxiv-2507-04890.description: Abstract We study spatiotemporal chaos in dense active suspensions using a generalized hydrodynamic model. As the activity is increased, we observe a clear structural transition marked by the formation of intense, spatially organized vortices with the appearance of giant number fluctuations.

arxiv-2508-09487.title: SARE: Semantic-Aware Reconstruction Error for Generalizable Diffusion-Generated Image Detection
arxiv-2508-09487.creator: Ju Yeon Kang, Jaehong Park, Semin Kim, Ji Won Yoon, Nam Soo Kim
arxiv-2508-09487.description: Abstract Recently, diffusion-generated image detection has gained increasing attention, as the rapid advancement of diffusion models has raised serious concerns about their potential misuse. While existing detection methods have achieved promising results, their performance often degrades significantly when facing fake images from unseen, out-of-distribution (OOD) generative models, since they primarily rely on model-specific artifacts.
